info.name: ActivTrak Public APIs Administration Administration - SCIM API

description.content:
ActivTrak's Public APIs provide REST endpoints for accessing digital activity reports (Live Data API) and for administering an ActivTrak instance (users, groups via SCIM 2.0, clients, consumers) plus bulk HR data import. Authentication is via an API key. Reference: https://developers.activtrak.com/
